comment: Every capability hit in dist/ must be listed here with a reason. Keep maxCount tight. File globs match chunk names without the content hash.

rules.why: XML namespace identifiers (SVG, XLink, XHTML, MathML) used by Preact's DOM renderer. Identifiers only, never requested.
Office Open XML namespace URIs inside SheetJS (xlsx reader). Identifiers compared against the uploaded file's XML; never requested. CSP connect-src would block them anyway.
Microsoft Office XML namespace URIs inside SheetJS. Identifiers only.
Strict OOXML / Dublin Core namespace URIs inside SheetJS. Identifiers only.
SheetJS internal namespace identifier. Never requested.
Plain links to IRD's FIF Australia tool and guidance, shown as text or an <a> the user may click (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer). Never fetched by the app; CSP connect-src would block it.
Source URL in the bundled RBNZ exchange-rate dataset's metadata (attribution). Never fetched.
